hero.title:
Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises from Miami:
What You Need to Know
hero.subtitle: Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises from Miami offer a more intimate alternative to traditional Caribbean cruising, combining all-suite accommodations, private terraces, personalized service, premium beverages, multiple dining venues, and a relaxed yacht atmosphere.
hero.description: Miami is an important departure point for The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection's Caribbean voyages, with itineraries ranging from short weekend-style escapes to longer island-hopping journeys. Current and upcoming collections include Miami round trips as well as Miami-to-San Juan itineraries, with destinations such as Bimini, Nassau, Great Exuma, Key West, and other Caribbean ports.

executivePhilosophy.title: Essential Questions Before Booking a Miami Yacht Cruise
executivePhilosophy.highlight: INTIMATE YACHTING ALTERNATIVE TO CARIBBEAN MEGA-SHIPS
paragraphs: If you are considering a Ritz-Carlton yacht cruise from Miami, the biggest questions are usually: Where does the yacht go? How long are Miami departures? What is included? Is it different from a traditional cruise? Are shore excursions included? Which yacht sails from Miami? Is it good for couples, families, or first-time cruisers? Should you stay in Miami before or after your voyage? Is a Miami departure convenient for a luxury Caribbean vacation?

This guide explains what to know before booking, providing a transparent breakdown of sailing lengths, destinations, yacht deployments, onboard inclusions, shoreside costs, and pre-cruise Miami planning tips.

Whether you are planning a 3-night Bahamas getaway to Bimini or a multi-island voyage to Puerto Rico, Miami serves as one of the most accessible and luxurious turnaround ports in the Caribbean collection.
executivePhilosophy.quote: Miami departures combine the vibrant culture and world-class hospitality of South Florida with intimate luxury yacht voyages through the Bahamas and Caribbean.

quickAnswerTable.title: Quick Answer: What Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises from Miami Like?

quickAnswerTable.takeaway: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection currently describes its voyages as an all-inclusive experience with all-suite accommodations, private terraces, dining, premium beverages, Suite Ambassador service, onboard gratuities, Wi-Fi and Marina access.

destinationsOverview.title: Where Do Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises from Miami Go?
destinationsOverview.subtitle: Miami departures primarily open the door to the Bahamas and Caribbean. The exact itinerary depends on the sailing date and yacht.
destinationsOverview.intro: Current Miami itineraries can include destinations such as Bimini, Nassau, Great Exuma, Key West, Sandy Point, Puerto Plata, Samaná, Grand Turk, and other Caribbean islands depending on the sailing.

cards.title: Miami to Miami Round-Trips
cards.description: A Miami round-trip itinerary can be particularly convenient if you want to avoid arranging transportation between different embarkation and disembarkation cities.
features: Miami → Bimini → Marina Day → Miami short escapes
Visits to Bimini, Nassau, Great Exuma, Key West & Sandy Point
Seamless round-trip flights through Miami International Airport
Perfect for long weekend luxury breaks and couples' escapes
cards.highlight: Ideal for travelers seeking maximum relaxation with minimal transit logistics.

cards.title: Miami to San Juan One-Way
cards.description: Some Miami departures travel one way toward Puerto Rico rather than returning to Miami, opening up deeper eastern Caribbean exploration.
features: Sails from Miami toward San Juan, Puerto Rico
Featured ports include Great Exuma, Puerto Plata & Samaná
Allows combining a yacht voyage with extended Puerto Rico resort stays
Explores diverse cultures, historical ports, and turquoise coves
cards.highlight: Useful if you want to combine a yacht voyage with a broader Caribbean vacation.

cards.title: Signature Bahamas & Caribbean Harbors
cards.description: Because of their nimble yacht scale, vessels access secluded anchorages and intimate boutique harbors unavailable to mega-ships.
features: Bimini: Crystal-clear diving, tranquil beaches, and marina sports
Great Exuma: Swimming with pigs and pristine sandbars
Key West: Vibrant culture, historic architecture, and sunset sailing
Puerto Plata & Samaná: Dominican rainforests, waterfalls & whale watching
cards.highlight: Experience world-famous ports without mega-ship cruise crowds.

voyageLengths.title: How Long Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises from Miami?
voyageLengths.subtitle: One of the advantages of Miami departures is the range of voyage lengths, from quick 3-night escapes to immersive 15-night voyages.
voyageLengths.lead: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection currently offers voyages ranging from approximately three to fifteen nights, depending on itinerary. Shorter sailings can work well for travelers looking for a luxury escape, while longer voyages allow more time for destination exploration. Miami is particularly relevant for shorter Caribbean voyages. The upcoming Caribbean collection includes three- and four-night round-trip voyages from Miami and San Juan, as well as longer five- to seven-night itineraries.

cards.title: Short Miami Yacht Cruises (3–5 Nights)
items: A long-weekend luxury getaway
A first experience with yacht cruising
A couples' escape
A pre- or post-Miami vacation
A short Caribbean vacation without committing to a week at sea

cards.title: Longer Miami Yacht Cruises (5–15 Nights)

yachtDeployment.title: Which Ritz-Carlton Yacht Sails from Miami?
yachtDeployment.subtitle: Understanding fleet deployment and vessel specifications for South Florida sailings.
yachtDeployment.text:
The specific yacht depends on the sailing date and itinerary. The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection currently operates multiple yachts, including Evrima, Ilma and Luminara. Its 2026 collection includes voyages aboard all three yachts, while upcoming collections continue to expand the itinerary options.

For Miami Caribbean itineraries, Ilma is particularly prominent in the current and upcoming Caribbean collections. Current official itinerary listings show multiple Miami round-trip voyages aboard Ilma. Because deployment can change by season, always check the exact yacht associated with your selected sailing.

marinaDayFeature.title: What Is a Marina Day?
paragraphs: A Marina Day is one of the features that distinguishes the Ritz-Carlton yacht experience from a conventional cruise.

At selected destinations, guests can access the yacht's Marina platform directly from the stern. Depending on conditions and location, activities can include swimming, kayaking, paddleboarding, snorkeling, and relaxing beside the water.

Current Miami-to-Bahamas itineraries feature Marina Days where guests can enjoy watersports and time directly from the yacht. For travelers who enjoy the ocean and water activities, this can become an important part of the experience.
highlights: Swimming: Direct ocean swimming in calm Caribbean coves
Kayaking: Complimentary kayaks for coastal paddling
Relaxing beside the water: Lounge with drink service at the water's edge

yachtVsTraditionalCruise.title: Is a Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruise from Miami Like a Traditional Cruise?
yachtVsTraditionalCruise.subtitle: Not exactly. The experience is still a voyage at sea, but the scale and atmosphere are different from a large conventional cruise ship.

sailing.label: Traditional Large Cruise Ship
points: Multiple large crowded pool decks and waterparks
Extensive family facilities and mega-ship kids clubs
Assigned dining seatings or massive buffet lines
Larger crowds and long gangway queues

allSuite.label: Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection
points: All-suite accommodations with private ocean terraces (100%)
Intimate smaller-scale yacht atmosphere (~298 to 448 guests)
Luxury dining across multiple venues + 24-hr in-suite dining
Relaxed, unhurried onboard experience with zero formal nights
Access to boutique smaller ports and secluded anchorages
Direct ocean access via the fold-out Marina platform

yachtVsTraditionalCruise.verdict: Neither format is inherently right for every traveler. The better choice depends on the type of vacation experience you want.

miamiRoundTripVsSanJuan.title: Miami Round Trip vs. Miami to San Juan
miamiRoundTripVsSanJuan.lead: Your choice of itinerary can affect overall vacation logistics, airfare, and hotel arrangements.
miamiRoundTripVsSanJuan.takeaway: A Miami round trip simplifies flight logistics with a single airport hub. A Miami-to-San Juan sailing is compelling if you want to visit Puerto Rico or combine the voyage with a broader Caribbean resort stay.

comparisonVsResort.title: Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection from Miami vs. Luxury Caribbean Resort
comparisonVsResort.lead: Some travelers considering Miami yacht cruises are choosing between a yacht vacation and a Caribbean land resort.
comparisonVsResort.takeaway: If you want to wake up somewhere different throughout the vacation without repacking, a yacht has a major structural advantage. If you prefer one resort, one beach, and complete control over daily schedules, a stationary resort may fit better.

faqs.question: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection sail from Miami?
faqs.answer: Yes. Miami is a current turnaround and departure point for Caribbean voyages, including round-trip itineraries and sailings to other Caribbean ports.

faqs.question: Where do Ritz-Carlton yachts go from Miami?
faqs.answer: Current and upcoming Miami itineraries include destinations such as Bimini, Nassau, Great Exuma, Key West and other Caribbean ports, depending on the voyage.

faqs.question: Are there short Ritz-Carlton yacht cruises from Miami?
faqs.answer: Yes. The current and upcoming Caribbean program includes three- and four-night round-trip voyages from Miami, in addition to longer sailings.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: The current fare includes all-suite accommodations, dining, premium beverages, Suite Ambassador service, onboard gratuities, Wi-Fi, entertainment and Marina access. Some services and experiences can cost extra.

faqs.question: Are shore excursions included?
faqs.answer: Shore excursions should be considered separately from the standard onboard inclusions. Available experiences and pricing depend on the destination and excursion selected.

faqs.question: Which yacht sails from Miami?
faqs.answer: The yacht assigned to a Miami sailing depends on the itinerary and season. Current Caribbean Miami itineraries prominently feature Ilma, while the wider fleet includes Evrima, Ilma and Luminara.

faqs.question: Are Ritz-Carlton yacht cruises good for couples?
faqs.answer: They can be a strong fit for couples who prefer an intimate yacht atmosphere, private terraces, personalized service and Caribbean destinations.

faqs.question: Are formal nights required?
faqs.answer: No. The current dress guidance is generally Yacht Casual, and formal attire is not required.

faqs.question: Does every suite have a private terrace?
faqs.answer: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection describes its accommodations as all-suite, with private terraces. Verify the exact configuration of the suite category you select.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Starlink Wi-Fi is currently included in the yacht fare.

faqs.question: Are gratuities included?
faqs.answer: Onboard gratuities for restaurant, bar and housekeeping services are included in the current fare.

faqs.question: Can I book a Miami round-trip yacht cruise?
faqs.answer: Yes. Current listings include Miami-to-Miami Caribbean itineraries.

faqs.question: Can I sail from Miami to San Juan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Current itinerary listings include Miami-to-San Juan voyages.

faqs.question: Should I stay in Miami before my yacht cruise?
faqs.answer: A pre-cruise Miami stay can be useful for reducing flight-delay risk and enjoying Miami before embarkation, especially for travelers flying into South Florida.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection a good choice for someone who dislikes large cruise ships?
faqs.answer: It may be worth considering because the yachts are designed around a more intimate, all-suite environment rather than the scale of a large conventional cruise ship.

faqs.question: Can Marriott Bonvoy members earn points on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?
faqs.answer: Yes. Current Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection information states that Marriott Bonvoy members can earn and redeem points in connection with eligible yacht voyages, with program terms applying.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book a Ritz-Carlton yacht from Miami?
faqs.answer: Luxury yacht availability can vary significantly by sailing date, suite category and itinerary. Travelers with specific dates, preferred suites or special occasions should consider planning well ahead.

faqs.question: Should I use a travel advisor to book a Ritz-Carlton yacht?
faqs.answer: An experienced luxury travel advisor can help compare sailings, suites, excursions, Miami hotels, transfers and the overall vacation itinerary.

finalAnswer.title: Final Takeaway: Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises from Miami
finalAnswer.lead: Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises from Miami provide a distinctive way to experience the Bahamas and Caribbean without the scale of a traditional mega-ship.
paragraphs: Miami is especially useful because the current collection includes short three- and four-night round trips as well as longer Caribbean voyages, giving travelers several ways to build a luxury getaway.

The experience centers on: All-suite accommodations, Private terraces, Personalized Suite Ambassador service, Multiple dining venues, Premium beverages, Included onboard gratuities, Complimentary Starlink Wi-Fi, Marina access and watersports, Caribbean destinations, and Relaxed yacht-style travel.

For travelers deciding between a traditional cruise, luxury resort, private yacht or Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection, the most useful comparison is not simply price. Consider service, accommodations, itinerary, inclusions, atmosphere, destination access and the way you want to spend your vacation.
If Miami is your starting point, a well-planned combination of Miami + Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection + Caribbean experiences can create a seamless luxury vacation.

@graph.description: A detailed guide to Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises from Miami, including Caribbean itineraries, destinations, inclusions, yacht options, excursions, costs and planning tips.

mainEntity.name: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection sail from Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Miami is a current departure and turnaround port for Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Caribbean voyages, including round-trip itineraries and sailings to other Caribbean destinations.

mainEntity.name: Where do Ritz-Carlton yachts go from Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depending on the sailing, Ritz-Carlton yacht itineraries from Miami can visit destinations such as Bimini, Nassau, Great Exuma, Key West and other Caribbean ports.

mainEntity.name: Are there short Ritz-Carlton yacht cruises from Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection offers short Caribbean voyages from Miami, including three- and four-night round-trip itineraries in its current and upcoming collections.

The current Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection fare includes all-suite accommodations, dining, premium beverages, Suite Ambassador service, onboard gratuities, Wi-Fi, entertainment and Marina access. Some services and experiences cost extra.

mainEntity.name: Are shore excursions included on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shore excursions are generally separate from the standard onboard inclusions. Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection offers group and private excursion options that may have additional costs.

mainEntity.name: Which Ritz-Carlton yacht sails from Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: The yacht assigned to a Miami sailing depends on the itinerary and season. Current Caribbean Miami itineraries include voyages aboard Ilma, while the wider Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection fleet includes Evrima, Ilma and Luminara.

mainEntity.name: Are Ritz-Carlton yacht cruises from Miami good for couples?

acceptedAnswer.text: They can be a good fit for couples who prefer an intimate yacht atmosphere, private terraces, personalized service, premium dining and Caribbean destinations.

mainEntity.name: Are formal nights required on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection uses a relaxed yacht-style dress approach, and formal attire is not required.

mainEntity.name: Does every Ritz-Carlton yacht suite have a private terrace?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection describes its accommodations as all-suite with private terraces. Travelers should verify the exact configuration of their selected suite category.

mainEntity.name: Is Wi-Fi included on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Complimentary Starlink Wi-Fi is currently included with the yacht fare.

mainEntity.name: Are gratuities included on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Onboard gratuities for restaurant, bar and housekeeping services are included in the current fare.

mainEntity.name: Can I take a Ritz-Carlton yacht round trip from Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Current Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection listings include Miami-to-Miami Caribbean itineraries.

mainEntity.name: Can I sail from Miami to San Juan on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection currently offers Miami-to-San Juan Caribbean itineraries on selected sailings.

mainEntity.name: Should I stay in Miami before a Ritz-Carlton yacht cruise?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pre-cruise Miami stay can help reduce travel-day stress and provide time to enjoy Miami before embarkation, especially when flying into South Florida.

mainEntity.name: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection good for people who dislike large cruise ships?

acceptedAnswer.text: It may appeal to travelers who prefer a smaller-scale yacht environment, all-suite accommodations and personalized service rather than the scale of a large conventional cruise ship.

mainEntity.name: Can Marriott Bonvoy members earn points with Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eligible Marriott Bonvoy members can earn and redeem points in connection with Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection voyages, subject to the program's current terms and conditions.

mainEntity.name: How much do Ritz-Carlton yacht cruises from Miami cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing varies based on sailing date, voyage length, yacht, suite category, itinerary, season and availability. The total vacation cost can also include airfare, hotels, transfers, shore excursions, insurance and other experiences.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I book a Ritz-Carlton yacht from Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury yacht availability can vary significantly by sailing date, suite category and itinerary. Travelers with specific dates, preferred suites or special occasions should consider planning well ahead.

mainEntity.name: Should I use a travel advisor to book a Ritz-Carlton yacht from Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: A luxury travel advisor can help compare Miami sailings, suite categories, itineraries, shore experiences, hotels, transfers and other components of the vacation.
